core: Replicative DNA synthesis at the fork
qualifier: error-prone translesion synthesis by POLI, POLK and REV1
name: Replicative DNA synthesis and error-prone translesion synthesis
rationale: All members are PCNA-associated polymerase steps of fork DNA synthesis (initiation, priming, elongation, polymerase switching, flap removal) or damage bypass by error-prone TLS polymerases, which separates the theme from base-excision gap filling, error-free POLH bypass and telomere C-strand synthesis.

core: Notch receptor activation and target transcription
qualifier: spanning NOTCH1-4, including NOTCH1 HD/translocation mutants
name: NOTCH1-4 activation and Notch target gene transcription
rationale: Members cover activation, nuclear signal transmission and transcriptional output of all four Notch paralogs plus constitutively active NOTCH1 mutants, whereas confusables centre on NOTCH1 ICD/PEST-FBXW7 degradation or NOTCH2-specific developmental contexts.

qualifier: primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation
name: Hematopoiesis toward primitive and definitive erythrocytes
rationale: All members concern blood cell formation with emphasis on primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, which the stem-cell homeostasis confusables lack, while the theme lacks the heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport of the erythroid-metabolism confusable.

qualifier: vitamin E handling and hereditary spastic paraplegia defects
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis, vitamin E and spastic paraplegia defects
rationale: Members share oxysterol/sterol hydroxylation routes to bile acids and related CYP/transporter defects (CTX, SPG5A, SPG56, SPG42) plus vitamin E metabolism, distinguishing them from bile acid transport/signaling, peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation and cholesterol biosynthesis confusables.

qualifier: positive regulation, PSD maintenance and receptor delivery
name: Promotion of postsynapse assembly and structural synaptic plasticity
rationale: All members build or strengthen the postsynaptic compartment (spine growth, PSD maintenance, receptor insertion, local translation, synapse maturation), whereas confusables emphasise dendritic arborization, negative spine regulation or calcium-driven LTP/LTD and memory.

qualifier: with glial activation and tau tangle regulation
name: Amyloid-beta production and clearance with glial activation control
rationale: Members centre on Alzheimer-associated amyloid-beta/APP formation, fibrillization and clearance together with regulation of microglial and astrocyte activation and neurofibrillary tangles, while confusables are microglial differentiation/cytotoxicity or lipoprotein signaling without amyloid processes.

qualifier: Mullerian duct derivatives and genitalia rather than gonad, prostate or kidney
name: Reproductive tract and genitalia development
rationale: All members describe development of the genital ducts (oviduct, uterus, vagina) and external genitalia, distinct from the gonadal sex-determination, prostate gland and ureteric bud confusables.

qualifier: in epithelial-mesenchymal transition and delamination
name: Cadherin junction remodeling in epithelial-mesenchymal transition
rationale: Members share control of cadherin cell-cell adhesion and adherens junctions in the context of EMT, delamination and Rho-restrained invasion, whereas confusables emphasise CDH gene transcription or apical junction assembly and polarity.

qualifier: PINK1-Parkin mitophagy and fission/fusion dynamics
name: PINK1-Parkin mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics regulation
rationale: All members concern the depolarisation-triggered PINK1/Parkin axis: mitochondrial protein localisation, membrane potential, mitophagy and fission/fusion control, unlike confusables on aggrephagy, receptor-mediated mitophagy/pexophagy or mitochondrial import and cristae formation.

qualifier: FRS2 and SHC cascades from FGFR1 and FGFR4
name: FRS2 and SHC MAPK signaling from FGFR1 and FGFR4
rationale: Members are the FRS- and SHC-adaptor routes to MAPK downstream of FGFR1 and FGFR4, distinguishing them from FGFR2/FGFR3 adaptor cascades and the PLC-gamma and PI3K branches.

core: Hematopoietic cytokine receptor signaling to STAT5
qualifier: IL-3/5/7/9 and FLT3 with CBL-mediated attenuation
name: IL-3/5/9 and FLT3 signaling to STAT5 with CBL attenuation
rationale: Members share STAT5/SHC signaling from IL-3, IL-5, IL-7, IL-9, G-CSF and FLT3 receptors and its CBL-dependent negative regulation, separating them from IL-2/IL-7 lymphoid signaling, EPO/TPO cascades and FLT3/FGFR1 fusion oncoproteins.

qualifier: transcription and mitoribosome quality control
name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitoribosome quality control
rationale: Members cover mitochondrial transcription initiation, termination and regulation plus mitoribosome-associated quality control, while confusables concern mtDNA replication, mitochondrial RNA processing/modification or translation elongation.

qualifier: neuronal apoptosis and FOXO-driven death transcription
name: Stress-induced neuronal apoptosis and FOXO death transcription
rationale: Members share regulation of apoptosis under cellular stress (neuronal death, ligand-absent extrinsic signaling, FOXO cell-death genes, mitochondrial UPR, CDK5 neurodegeneration), unlike confusables on p75NTR dependence receptors, AKT-FOXO metabolic genes or HSF1 heat shock.

qualifier: tRNA maturation and aminoacylation plus translation-factor modification
name: tRNA maturation, aminoacylation and translation factor modification
rationale: Members support accurate translation via tRNA splicing, 3' processing, anticodon modification and aminoacylation plus hypusine, diphthamide and hydroxylation of translation factors and termination/readthrough control, which the RNA-modification and mitochondrial-RNA confusables lack.

qualifier: IL-5 signaling and restraint of Th2 cytokines
name: Eosinophil differentiation, activation and IL-5 signaling
rationale: Members centre on eosinophil (and related granulocyte/mast cell) development, migration and activation with IL-5 signaling and negative control of IL-4/IL-5/Th2, while confusables centre on positive Th2 differentiation, IL-4/13/33 signaling and IgE switching.

qualifier: with methionine-responsive translation initiation and ribosome biogenesis
name: Non-histone protein methylation and methionine-responsive translation initiation
rationale: Members combine lysine/arginine protein methylation (including p53) with methionine sensing, cap-dependent translation initiation and ribosome biogenesis control, distinguishing them from chromatin-remodeling, histone modification and rRNA transcription confusables.

qualifier: interneuron tangential migration and neuron-type specification
name: Forebrain neuron specification and interneuron tangential migration
rationale: Members cover forebrain-specific neuron development (cortical regionalization, GABAergic interneuron and olfactory precursor migration, pyramidal and thalamic development), distinct from hindbrain/cerebellar, cortical layering and retinal/pituitary confusables.

qualifier: glucocorticoid and aldosterone secretion and response
name: Regulation of glucocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion
rationale: Members regulate adrenal glucocorticoid and mineralocorticoid production, secretion, ACTH control and cellular response, whereas confusables are steroidogenic enzyme pathways and their defects, behavioural stress responses, or thyroid hormone.

qualifier: with IL-17/Th17 axis
name: IL-1 family cytokine processing and IL-17/Th17 signaling
rationale: Members share IL-1, IL-18, IL-36 and IL-38 processing and signaling together with IL-17 production and Th17 commitment, which separates them from inflammasome/pyroptosis, C-type lectin antifungal and IL-10/12/23/27 confusables.

qualifier: via STAT3 and ERK activation
name: IL-6 family cytokine signaling via STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members cover IL-6, IL-11, CNTF, LIF and OSM receptor-ligand signaling with STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation and its negative regulation, unlike confusables centred on common-gamma-chain cytokines, IL-10/12/23/27 or interferon-gamma.

core: MHC class I and II antigen processing and presentation
qualifier: proteasome, cross-presentation and APC surface signatures
name: MHC I/II antigen processing, cross-presentation and APC signatures
rationale: Members share antigen processing (proteasome, ER-phagosome and endosomal routes), MHC I/II peptide loading and its viral subversion, plus dendritic cell, monocyte and B cell surface signatures, whereas confusables concern PD-L1 turnover, NKT regulation or NK/T cytotoxicity.

qualifier: with histone pre-mRNA 3'-end processing
name: snRNA biogenesis, snRNP assembly and histone mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members span Pol II/III snRNA transcription, cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly together with SLBP-linked histone mRNA 3' processing and Pol II termination, unlike confusables centred on splice-site recognition, polyadenylation or nuclear RNA decay.

qualifier: gangliosides and GM2/sialidosis defects
name: Lysosomal ganglioside and glycosphingolipid catabolism
rationale: Members describe lysosomal breakdown of gangliosides and glycosphingolipids and its HEXA/HEXB/NEU1 deficiencies, distinct from glycosaminoglycan degradation (mucopolysaccharidoses), glycosylation and sialic acid metabolism confusables.

qualifier: heart rate and force via sequestered calcium release
name: Heart rate and contractility regulation via calcium release
rationale: All members modulate cardiac rate, force and relaxation, largely through release of sequestered calcium and membrane potential, distinguishing them from skeletal-muscle ryanodine receptor and SERCA/fiber-type confusables.

qualifier: renal vesicle to S-shaped body tubule formation
name: Nephron tubule formation via mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition
rationale: Members describe epithelial nephron formation in the metanephros (MET, renal vesicle, comma- and S-shaped bodies, tubule differentiation), separate from mesenchyme maintenance, proximal/distal patterning and distal segment development confusables.
